title: How to enhance the texture of a lipstick in a product photo with AI?
h1: How to enhance the texture of a lipstick in a product photo with AI?
metaTitle: How do you highlight the details of a lipstick?
description: In this detailed guide, discover how to highlight the textures and details of your cosmetic products for visuals that encourage e-commerce visitors to make a purchase.
tool: Orbitvu Station software and a lipstick
introText:
Product photography plays an essential role in e-commerce and cosmetic marketing, which is why it is important to capture details, especially texture. It is advisable for cosmetics, fashion and many other fields to offer close-ups of products to highlight texture.

The more information visitors to your website have about products, the more likely they are to make a purchase. 🛒

This guide takes you step-by-step through the steps needed to enhance the texture of a lipstick and obtain detailed visuals. 💄

Also discover our guide to enhance the texture of a blush through a packshot.

steps.title: Place and center the lipstick
steps.content:
Place the lipstick in the exact center of the turntable. The studio has a integrated laser centering system to ensure accurate positioning, thus avoiding rotation errors that could affect the quality of the animation. 📍

You can also help yourself with center point of the plateau. Finally, check on your screen that the product is in the center and well oriented in front of the camera. 💻

✨ Tip : Make sure the lipstick is stable. If you are working on a small or cylindrical product that may move, use a piece of adhesive tape or clear double-sided tape.
steps.structuredText: Above all, choose a stable and clean support to put your lipstick on. Ideally, use a turntable or an anti-reflective surface. Make sure the product is perfectly centered in the frame of your camera for a balanced and professional look. Point the lipstick stick slightly toward the camera to highlight its texture and contours, while avoiding direct reflections. Tip: Using a positioning laser, as offered by devices such as Orbitvu Station, ensures precise alignment that reduces subsequent adjustments.

steps.title: Choosing an AI template
steps.content:
The Orbitvu AI Assistant comes with a powerful feature to suggest the best light configurations depending on the type of product. 💄

Once your lipstick is positioned, click on the “AI” icon and let the AI Assistant Scan the product and offer several adapted lighting options.🤖

The AI will offer you 4 light templates different, choose the one that highlights your lipstick the most. For our packshot we chose the Posh template.
steps.structuredText: AI-assisted tools, such as modern capture software (for example, AI Photo Assistant), are essential allies. Selecting a template will allow you to maintain consistency and optimize your settings from the start: Choose a template adapted to cosmetic products to have automatic recommendations concerning the light and the angle of exposure. This can significantly reduce the time spent on technical adjustments while ensuring a consistent result.

steps.title: Adjusting the light and the camera
steps.content:
Lighting is the key element in magnifying the reliefs of a product. Lipstick, with its semi-matt or glossy texture, can reflect differently depending on the light sources. 💡

Adjust your device settings: Low ISO (100-200) to minimize digital noise, Medium opening (f/8 to f/11) for optimal sharpness and shutter speed stable at 1/125. 📷
steps.structuredText: Lighting is the key element in magnifying the reliefs of a product. Lipstick, with its semi-matt or glossy texture, can reflect differently depending on the light sources. Adjust your camera settings: low ISO (100-200) to minimize digital noise, medium aperture (f/8 to f/11) for optimal sharpness, and a stable shutter speed at 1/125.

steps.title: Start shooting
steps.content:
After taking a photo by pressing the 📷 icon to check that all settings are optimal, click “Capture All” to start shooting. 🎬

For photos that require sharp textured details, you can use the technique of Focus Stacking with Orbitvu's Superfocus tool. 🔍

Discover the focus stacking technique in our jewelry tutorial.
steps.structuredText: Once the product is positioned and the settings are made, proceed with the capture: Use a tripod and shoot remotely to avoid shaking. Take multiple shots, adjusting the angles slightly to find the best perspective. For photos that require sharp textured details, consider focus stacking (for example with OrbitVu's Superfocus tool). This will allow you to get the perfect depth of field.

steps.title: Retouch colors
steps.content:
Photo editing plays a key role in enhancing the texture of a lipstick. 💄

Adjust the tint And the saturation to make the product match its physical version, while making it appealing on the screen.
steps.structuredText: Photo editing plays a key role in enhancing the texture of a lipstick. Start by correcting the white balance to reflect the actual color of the product: Use tools like Adobe Lightroom or the Orbitvu Station editing module, which includes built-in color calibration. Then, adjust the hue and saturation so that the product exactly matches its physical version, while making it appealing on the screen.

steps.title: Increase sharpness and contrast
steps.content:
At this stage, highlight the texture: 💡

  • Apply a slight increase in local sharpness to the stick.
  • Subtly enhance contrasts to highlight streaks and reliefs.

However, avoid amplifying these changes excessively, at the risk of giving an artificial appearance or denaturating the product. 🚨
steps.structuredText: At this stage, highlight the texture so that it is visible even on low resolution screens: Apply a slight increase in local sharpness to the stick. Subtly enhance contrasts to highlight streaks and reliefs. However, avoid amplifying these changes excessively, at the risk of giving an artificial appearance or denaturating the product.

steps.title: Use the AutoPolisher tool
steps.content:
One of the advantages of Orbitvu is its Autopolisher, which automatically edits your images to correct minor blemishes, adjust contrasts, and improve sharpness.

steps.title: Export the final photo
steps.content:
Once your photo is perfect, export it in the format required for your platform. 📤

  • Web format : JPG or PNG with a resolution of 72 dpi.
  • Impression : High resolution TIFF or PSD format.

Solutions like Orbitvu allow you to publish directly from the Obitvu Station software to marketplaces like Shopify or Magento. 💻

faqs.question: Do I need advanced retouching skills to use the AutoPolisher?
faqs.answer: No, the AutoPolisher is integrated into a guided workflow, allowing operators without retouching training to produce professional-looking visuals. Advanced settings are still available, but most adjustments are automated.

faqs.question: How does this workflow improve the productivity of an e-commerce team?
faqs.answer: Thanks to automation (AI Assistant, AutoPolisher, settings templates), each team member can quickly repeat the same procedure without the need for in-depth photography knowledge, allowing more visuals to be produced in less time.

faqs.question: What is the impact on the return on investment (ROI) for cosmetic and fashion brands?
faqs.answer: By offering high-quality images that value textures, you reduce returns and increase sales, improving profitability. In addition, automation speeds up production, which considerably reduces the costs associated with repeated shootings.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of using focus stacking compared to simple shooting?
faqs.answer: Focus stacking allows for maximum sharpness in all areas of the lipstick, which is essential for complex details. Unlike simple shooting, it eliminates the problems associated with a reduced depth of field.

faqs.question: Is it possible to visualize the impact of my lighting or framing adjustments live?
faqs.answer: Yes, live shooting via Orbitvu Station allows you to immediately see the result of each adjustment, avoiding trial and error and speeding up the creation process.
